title: Solo PT / online coach client-management template
core_problem: All-in-one coaching SaaS is expensive/overkill; spreadsheets get chaotic past ~15 clients.
desired_outcome: Manage programming, check-ins and progress without paying for bloated software.

problems.statement: Coaches actively seek a manageable client system.
symptoms: r/personaltraining thread 'What software are you using to manage clients?' — trainers named 9+ tools (Trainerize, TrueCoach, SuperSet, Everfit, ...).

problems.statement: Template (not another app) is the wedge.
symptoms: In-thread ask: 'do you have any template you can share?' — direct want for a template.

problems.statement: Coaches pay monthly; open to cheaper one-time tool.
symptoms: Coaching SaaS runs $20-150/mo, expensive for a 10-client coach; summary of coach software pain points.

solution_gaps: 'better than a spreadsheet, cheaper than SaaS' one-time template
creator_ecosystem: inferred very large (fitness creators) but not measured
digital_product_fit: Good: Notion/Sheets client-management template (~$15-29). Caveat: crowded w/ cheap apps.

demand_evidence.rationale: Recurring subreddit threads + explicit template asks.

pain_importance.rationale: Admin time directly cuts billable capacity.

existing_wtp.rationale: Pay SaaS monthly; template WTP unproven, plus free apps compete.

solution_gap.rationale: Field crowded with cheap/free indie apps.
